objectives: This course aims to develop students’ ability to apply sustainability and management concepts to real world organizational challenges through field based projects. Students will gain practical experience in analyzing market and stakeholder needs, identifying sustainability related challenges, and developing feasible strategies and solutions.
content:
This course is organized around two field projects related to sustainability and social impact. The first project focuses on the People and Planet First Market, in which students will analyze target customers, market positioning, communication strategies, and promotional approaches, and develop practical marketing recommendations to increase awareness and engagement.

The second project focuses on a social enterprise project. Students will work with a selected social enterprise or sustainability related initiative to identify key challenges, analyze stakeholder needs, and develop practical solutions that support both social impact and organizational sustainability.

Throughout the course, students will participate in project planning, field research, stakeholder engagement, team discussion, strategy development, implementation, and final presentation. The course emphasizes learning by doing and encourages students to apply sustainability concepts, business knowledge, and impact thinking to real world challenges.
